result.reason: The operative language adds the preferred mutual aggregate cap and the required uncapped carve-outs, while retaining the mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages. It also appropriately excludes payment obligations from the cap. The change is confined to liability allocation and does not disturb unrelated commercial terms. Minor drafting imperfections remain: the lookback runs from the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim itself, “amounts paid or payable” is broader than “fees,” and the payment-obligation clarification applies to both parties rather than only Customer. The inherited typographical error in subsection (a) also remains. These issues do not materially prevent the clause from reaching the preferred position.
